title: Online Iterative Self-Alignment for Radiology Report Generation

layout.note: Two stacked full-width dashed frames: the top band (data construction) holds the green Step 1 region and the orange Step 2 region side by side, the bottom band (alignment) holds the updated model, the reference model, the reward models and the datasets from left to right. The flow runs rightwards on top, down a red arrow at the right edge, leftwards below and back up along a red line at the left edge, a clockwise loop.

lesson: Close an iterative method with a single coloured return arrow labelled Next Iteration around two titled dashed module frames, and use colour pairs to tie each objective's weight, reward margin and loss line together.
